prompts.name: Translate and polish
prompts.text: Translate the supplied text into my target language preserving meaning, intent, register and structure. Ask for a missing target language only. Use idiomatic language rather than literal substitutions. Preserve numbers, units, links, code, placeholders and proper names unless instructed otherwise. Maintain a consistent glossary; flag genuinely ambiguous phrases without silently inventing meaning. Return the finished translation separately from brief translator notes. For Persian, handle RTL and embedded English terms carefully.
